Attend · Research Roundtables

Research Roundtables

Small-group, focused discussions on key topics in machine learning for health.

About the roundtables

Research roundtables are a hallmark of the ML4H community experience. These intimate, structured discussions bring together small groups of researchers to engage deeply with specific topics — from methodological challenges to deployment realities to open problems in the field.

Each table has a senior and a junior chair. Roundtables run in two sessions, one on each day of the symposium.
